guidance: Host enable/kill: loopback owner, one-use 120-second invite, exact executable/PID/start/window pin, 1-60 minute expiry
Native Being controlled remotely indicator owns Stop now; closing it, lost backend heartbeat or physical input revokes
Relay owner HTTP /api/ui/remote: connect/disconnect/windows/snapshot/frame/input/log; bot tools only observe existing connections
Input: background click/type_text/navigation press_key/one-step vertical scroll if native patterns support it; no global keyboard, clipboard, launches, grants or approvals
Enter credentials on host. Password values/actions are omitted from text projections, and protected or unclassified focused fields refuse typing; no account/provider credentials or cookies forwarded
Frames/session/input logs have no disk recording; shared log redacts text/results/element labels before queuing

Unknown password state does not exclude a window. The native driver omits password values/actions and checks both the exact target and actual focused control before remote typing. Protected and unclassified focused controls refuse input. Paul enters credentials on the host.
Remote UIA projections are bounded and refreshed incrementally; projectionTruncated marks a partial view. A missing control needs a new observation or host interaction, never guessed input.

The remote bot API only observes existing owner connections; snapshot is a fresh protected read, never an input/grant effect. Real remote native window/input and the visible host indicator require an outside allowed device or agent desktop.
